messages:
miguel: Quick update  ArboRData just signed a 12-month Dedicated renewal and we launched their DigitalOcean Marketplace listing this AM: https://marketplace.digitalocean.com/apps/arbor-redwood. They migrated their real-time inference to Redwood Dedicated on DO Kubernetes. Huge win for small-mid market fintech. :tada:

leah: Amazing! Renewal highlights? Committed capacity, discount, timeline?

sam: Sales note: 6 reserved GPUs (DO droplet-GPU), 20% committed discount, dedicated support window for first 30 days. ArboRData plans a phased cutover over 3 weeks.

.do-marketplace-bot: DigitalOcean Marketplace listing published (Offer Slug: arbor-redwood-2026). Marketplace trial token available.

nora: Legal confirmed the case study language and the public quote. ArboRData approved: "Redwood helped us get predictable inference performance on a tight budget."

miguel: Assets uploaded: https://drive.redwood.internal/partners/arbor-data-do (case-study.pdf, topology.svg, 20s demo.mp4). Marketing  can you queue blog + social?

marketing-bot: Draft blog saved in CMS: "ArboRData scales realtime inference with Redwood Dedicated on DigitalOcean Marketplace". Assigned to leah (due: 2026-07-12). Draft social copy and hero image in Drive.

leah: Can eng-docs add a short how-to for DO Marketplace + Dedicated? 3 bullets would suffice: accept offer, link DO account, follow Dedicated onboarding checklist. Also want a console banner for next Wed.

sre: Onboarding note: ArboRData requested per-tenant KV-cache presets and warmup for cold starts. We'll publish a short runbook (steps + recommended batch sizes) by Friday. Also recommending q4_0 quant profile for their transformer.

sam: Any early Marketplace telemetry? Curious about discovery from DO users.

.do-marketplace-bot: Day 1 metrics: 9 listing views, 2 trial starts, 1 inquiry via Marketplace. Will post 24h digest.

legal: Confirmed final quote for press pack: "Redwood delivered the predictable performance we needed while lowering inference costs." ArboRData signed off.

miguel: Sales ops: this renewal moves ARR into Reserved capacity in next quarter. Finance  please flag for forecast.

leah: Also planning a customer webinar with ArboRData ENG to demo the migration and tuning. Tentative date: July 20. I'll add invites after marketing approves copy.

sre: I'll schedule a 1:1 tuning session for their engineers during onboarding week and include KV-cache metrics dashboard templates.

marketing-bot: Social assets ready. Proposed tweet: "ArboRData scaled realtime inference on DigitalOcean with Redwood Dedicated  predictable performance, lower cost. Read the case study." Queued pending legal ok.

miguel: Thanks team  great cross-functional move into DO Marketplace. If anyone needs changes to assets or quote, DM me. We'll publish blog once marketing finishes final edits. :rocket:
